detail.title: Riser 20 Heavy-Duty Metal Monitor & Laptop Stand
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Riser 20 is a heavy-duty metal monitor and laptop stand designed to double as a desk organiser, supporting up to 25kg on its sturdy metal frame. A mesh platform improves airflow beneath a laptop, printer or monitor while keeping the desktop tidy, and the raised design frees up space underneath for keyboards, notebooks or other accessories. Its all-metal construction gives it real stability compared to lightweight plastic risers, making it a dependable choice for anyone looking to organise a busy desk while elevating their screen to a more comfortable working height.
